title: Placement – venue materials
slide_intent: Teach a two-level signature hierarchy. A visitor should be able to identify a particular venue and also recognize the institution behind it.
strategic_value: Giving the venue priority and the trust a consistent endorsement can connect the six venues without erasing their individual names.
demonstration: Two gray layouts hold the large Kelham Island Museum mark at the top. A much smaller trust seal moves from bottom center in the primary example to bottom right in the secondary example.
practical_value: For venue communications, lead with the venue mark and choose a smaller trust placement after checking the bottom-center option.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy guidance
content_islands.spec: Keep the left text focused on relative prominence and the trust’s role across the venues.

content_islands.name: Primary venue layout
content_islands.spec: Set the venue mark high on a portrait field and place the trust seal at bottom center. Label the primary position.

content_islands.name: Secondary venue layout
content_islands.spec: Keep the venue mark high and move the small seal to the lower right. Align its callout with the changed position.
